name: obsidian-unimian
description: Add Calendar, Swimlane, Gantt, and Timeline views to Bases without prescribing a task management workflow.

scripts.lint: biome lint src scripts tests esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs vitest.config.mts package.json manifest.json biome.jsonc eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json --diagnostic-level=error
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src scripts tests esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs vitest.config.mts package.json manifest.json biome.jsonc eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:obsidian && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:obsidian && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:artifacts
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Parkis Utama
